description: Lists the signed-in user's aliases, newest first, with their note, on/off status and how many emails each one forwarded or blocked. Use to find an alias by address or note, or to filter by status. Results are paginated, 50 per page.

search.description: Optional text to find in the alias address or note, 3 to 50 characters.

status.description: Which aliases to return: "all", "active" (forwarding on) or "inactive" (turned off).

name: list_aliases
title: List aliases
